title: Transform Chain Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Kinematics
description: Turn the two joints of a flat two-link arm and watch the two link vectors add up to the position of the tip. Then work out one coordinate of the tip in six problems, using the forward kinematics formulas, and check each answer. Used in Chapter 12.

educational.topic: Forward kinematics of a flat two-link arm
learningObjectives: Calculate the tip position of a flat two-link arm from its joint angles using the forward kinematics equations, to within 0.001 m, in six problems, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore the two link vectors with sliders, then calculate a tip coordinate and get an immediate check
keyQuestions: Why does the second link point at theta1 + theta2 and not at theta2 alone?
What happens to the tip when only theta1 changes?
commonMisconceptions: The second link points at the angle theta2 alone
Angles in degrees can be passed straight to sine and cosine in code
The tip position is the sum of the two angles
assessmentOpportunities: Six typed answers, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery
